body.upstream_repo: actumn/celery.node (a Node.js Celery client/worker port, unrelated to Paradox)

_decoded.genuine_paradox_maintainer_evidence: npm maintainer email is thanh.nguyenhoang@paradox.ai -- confirmed Paradox employee. Note the upstream 'author' field (actumn814@gmail.com) was left unchanged from the original project, which is why this could be mistaken for the original at a glance -- the MAINTAINER field, not author, is the real ownership signal here.
_decoded.interpretation: An actively maintained (42 published versions over ~16 months) internal fork of a Node.js Celery client, published under a personal npm scope by a named Paradox engineer, following the same '@prd-<username>' convention as the pdf-lib fork. Corroborates the recon-plan hypothesis that Paradox runs a Python/Celery task-queue backend with a Node.js service that needs to enqueue/consume Celery tasks cross-language (a polyglot backend signal) -- this is a real, live, currently-maintained package, not an abandoned side project.
